places.note: Stable stone at y94 above the signed lower turn. Look southeast to the cobble lip. Approach in daylight.

refuge.access: Use the west birch door by hand and close it behind you.
refuge.hazards: Use the grassy west approach. The gravel to the east drops downhill.
